arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import os
total = 0; files = 0; entries = 0; biggest = 0
for base, dirs, names in os.walk('submission'):
    entries += len(dirs) + len(names)
    for n in names:
        p = os.path.join(base, n)
        st = os.lstat(p)
        files += 1; total += st.st_size
        biggest = max(biggest, st.st_size)
        assert st.st_nlink == 1, p
print('files', files, 'entries', entries, 'total bytes', total, 'biggest', biggest, 'limits 128/512/2MiB/256KiB')
" && python3 check.py submission 2>&1 | tail -3
